label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y maldiciente de su padre y su madre, de morir morirá.
spanish: Y maldiciente de su padre y su madre, de morir será muerto.
grammarChanges: Changed morirá (qal active, "he will die") to será muerto (passive) to restore the Hophal imperfect 3ms stem force of יוּמָת ("he will be put to death").
readerNote: Kept "de morir" on the infinitive absolute because that is the same licensed rendering already used for this construction at Éxodo 21:15 ("de morir será muerto"); only the finite verb's stem force was repaired.
